description.value:
You have become an instrument of the Maker’s truth. Your voice no longer requires effort. It simply is.

Word of Judgment. When you use Voice of Authority, you can affect an additional creature of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you. It must make a separate Wisdom saving throw.

Irresistible Cadence. Once per turn when a creature succeeds on its saving throw against your Stunning Strike or Voice of Authority, you can spend 2 Focus Points to force it to reroll the d20. It must use the new result.
